one_liner: Senior supervisor at U.S. Cyber Command who builds university partnerships and turns cyber workforce gaps into academic curriculum and training requirements.
fit_summary: This GG-14 supervisory role requires a year leading cyber workforce education programs, managing government-university partnerships or analyzing the cyber workforce, with no education substitute, plus a Top Secret clearance. Daniel's training work (aligning EMI courses with FEMA field manuals) is far from cyber workforce leadership, so skip it.
eligibility: Hiring path is listed as public, but the posting says only applicants meeting specific employment authority categories may apply, and proof of the category is required.

You need 1 year of specialized experience at senior level, and education cannot substitute. That means leading cyber workforce education or training, managing partnerships with colleges or universities, or running workforce analyses of competencies and talent levels.
A Top Secret clearance is required, and you would need to be able to obtain one.
This is a Cyber Excepted Service position.
keywords: colleges, universities, or other educational institutions
strategy: Skip this one: it requires a year leading cyber workforce education programs, government-university partnerships or cyber workforce analysis, and his training work (aligning EMI courses with FEMA field manuals) is far from that.
Lower-grade workforce development, training or emergency preparedness roles, for example at FEMA or in Virginia or county emergency management, fit him better now.
resume_bullets: Aligned training goals between Emergency Management Institute courses and FEMA field guide training manuals.
Screened and contacted registered translator volunteers for DoD language requests at the National Language Service Corps (2018).
interview_questions: How have you turned an organization's operational workforce gaps into specific training or curriculum requirements?
Describe a partnership you managed between a government organization and an educational institution. What made it succeed?
How would you align academic initiatives with the future needs of the cyber workforce?

watch_outs: The specialized experience is cyber- and academia-specific with no education substitution, so you will likely be rated not qualified without that background.
A Top Secret clearance is required, and the role is supervisory at GG-14.
The job is fully on-site at Fort Meade with no telework, a long commute from Manassas.
